description: Return the SLA policy metric targets applied to one Zendesk ticket.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for retrieving a ticket's SLA policy metrics.

ticket_id.description: ID of the Zendesk ticket, as a string.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: GetTicketSlaPolicyMetricsRequest

name: get_ticket_sla_policy_metrics

GetTicketSlaPolicyMetricsResponse.description: SLA policy metrics applied to a ticket.

policy_metrics.description: Active, achieved, or breached SLA policy metric targets.
policy_metrics.title: Policy Metrics

GetTicketSlaPolicyMetricsResponse.title: GetTicketSlaPolicyMetricsResponse

TicketSlaPolicyMetric.description: An SLA policy metric target applied to a ticket.

breach_at.description: Timestamp when the SLA target is or was due to breach.
breach_at.title: Breach At

days.description: Duration relative to the SLA target when Zendesk reports days.
days.title: Days

metric.description: SLA metric being measured, such as first_reply_time.
metric.title: Metric

minutes.description: Duration relative to the SLA target when Zendesk reports minutes.
minutes.title: Minutes

stage.description: Current metric stage, such as active, achieved, or breached.
stage.title: Stage

TicketSlaPolicyMetric.title: TicketSlaPolicyMetric
